_readme: Settings for the parent's progress page. Edit here; no code change needed.
targetPercent: the dashed target line on each bar, and the start of green.
amberFromPercent: amber runs from here up to targetPercent; below it is red.
minAnswers: a topic with fewer answers than this is drawn as a faded grey bar and left out of Focus next.
focusCount: how many topics the Focus next card suggests.
trendDays: the trend arrow compares the score now with the score this many days ago.
englishSkillFamilies: groups English question types. Topic names match the question bank's typeOfQuestion, ignoring case. A type not listed here appears under 'Other skills'.
